summary_1line: Bhishma explains who deserves gifts and begins a discourse, via Narada and the apsara Panchachuda, on perceived faults and nature of women.

image_candidates.scene_text: The celestial sage Narada meets the radiant apsara Panchachuda in the heavenly realm and questions her about the nature of women.
Bhishma lies on his bed of arrows while instructing Yudhishthira about righteous giving and the qualities of honorable people.
